meta.title: Nightfall Launcher — a fast, free Minecraft: Java Edition launcher
meta.desc: Nightfall is a free, ad-free Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Windows with one-click performance, Modrinth built in, an in-game mod toggle and automatic updates.
hero.tag: Free, no ads, made for Windows
hero.title:
Play Minecraft.
Nothing in the way.
hero.lead: Nightfall is a calm, fast launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition. One click for better FPS, mods from Modrinth, and a mod switch right inside the game.
hero.smartscreen: Windows warning? Click More info, then Run anyway. The installer isn't code-signed yet.
hero.signin: Microsoft sign-in is built in and waiting on Mojang's approval. Until then, singleplayer works in dev mode.
feat.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
feat.sub: Built for players who want to press Play and have it just work, with the controls there when you want them.
feat.soonNote: Features marked 0.2 are finished and arrive in the next update. The screenshots show 0.2.
feat.perf.d: The Performance profile installs Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast and ModernFix, matched to your version.
feat.modrinth.d: Search mods, modpacks, shaders and resource packs. Dependencies install themselves, updates take one click, and .mrpack files import.
feat.toggle.d: Press the N button on the title screen, switch mods on or off, then Apply & Restart. You're back in a few seconds.
feat.update.d: Install once. New versions download quietly in the background and install when you close the launcher.
feat.crash.d: Over 100 known crashes, each with the cause in plain words and fixes in order, plus one-click actions like more RAM or the right Java.
feat.simple.d: One big Play button and nothing else, for anyone who doesn't want menus. Advanced mode is one switch away.
feat.shared.d: Keybinds, video and audio settings follow you across every instance and Minecraft version.
feat.loaders.d: Any release or snapshot, vanilla or Fabric, with the exact Java Mojang ships. Quilt, plus Forge and NeoForge (experimental), come in 0.2.
feat.access.d: High contrast, reduced motion, a dyslexia-friendly font, UI scaling and full keyboard navigation, in 23 languages.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.sub: Can't find yours? Ask on Discord. Game crashed? Try crash help first.
faq.a1: Yes. Nightfall is free, with no ads and no paid tiers. You still need to own Minecraft: Java Edition to play online.
faq.q2: Windows says "Windows protected your PC". Is it safe?
faq.a2: The installer isn't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen warns about every new app. Click More info, then Run anyway. Only download Nightfall from this website or the official GitHub releases.
faq.q3: Why can't I sign in with Microsoft yet?
faq.a3: Sign-in is built, but Minecraft's services only accept a new launcher after Mojang approves it. Until then, Settings > Developer has an offline mode for singleplayer. Online servers work as soon as approval comes in.
faq.q4: Does it work on macOS or Linux?
faq.a4: Right now Nightfall is built and tested for Windows 10 and 11.
faq.a5: Nightfall checks when it starts and every few hours, downloads quietly and shows Update ready with a Restart button. Version 0.1.0 can't update itself, so install the latest version once.
faq.a6: Fabric works today. Quilt, Forge and NeoForge (experimental) arrive in 0.2.
faq.a7: Open crash help and paste your log, or use /crash in our Discord. Both match it against over 100 known crashes and tell you the fix.
faq.a8: No. Nightfall is an independent project. It isn't an official Minecraft product and isn't approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
faq.a9: Almost nothing. Your sign-in happens on Microsoft's own page and tokens stay encrypted on your PC. See the privacy policy.
